changelog:
**Major update: Paid, on-chain verifiable scan option added alongside free, instruction-only mode.**

- Added support for live, paid regex scans via the DCL Trust Oracle MCP server, settled on-chain with x402 (USDC on Base).
- Both free (instruction-only, no network call) and paid (real regex, cryptographically sealed) modes use the same S1–S8 detection checklist.
- Output from the live scan includes a transaction hash, audit chain proof, and verification URL; only redacted match samples and input hashes are ever stored.
- Updated documentation to reflect new usage instructions, categories, and integration details for MCP/x402.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
summary: Scan AI agent outputs, tool results, and pipeline data for exposed secrets and credentials — API keys, tokens, private keys, database URLs, .env values — before they reach users, logs, or downstream systems. Runs as a free instruction-only checklist, or as a real, paid regex scan via the live DCL...
